snippet.title: Mazey Village Release Date Trailer
snippet.description:
🌪️ Mazey Village launches August 5, 2026 on Steam!

A tornado has devastated Mazey Village, leaving homes destroyed and villagers stranded. Explore maze-like biomes, recover lost belongings, rescue villagers, and rebuild the town into a thriving community.

✨ Restore the village
🧩 Explore maze-like regions
🏡 Customize your town
🐮 Meet villagers and animals
🔍 Discover secrets and hidden treasures

Wishlist now:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1766240
